topic: Get your hours, phone, and address consistent everywhere online

script.hook: Wrong hours online cost you customers.
beats: Search Google, Yelp, and Facebook. Make sure your hours match everywhere.
Your phone number must be identical on every single listing you own.
Check your address too. One typo sends customers straight to your competitor.
